values: A localized Gaussian-witness lower bound for fractional iterated area on uniform grids. Limits: No original lower-bound-target gap asserted. Rough range (1/4,1/2) is candidate new residual; Brownian optimum and smooth-range asymptotic rate are credited. No sharp constant, normalized limit, endpoints, arbitrary mesh or adaptive sampling claimed. Prior results and proof dependencies are credited in the paper.
